verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is an agent-testing and simulation platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence shows no first-party MCP server or endpoint that lets an agent operate Chronicle. The only MCP mention (docs-16) says a custom environment version can describe MCP servers inside a simulated world. That is user-supplied test-environment content, not an official Chronicle MCP server, so it is not credited.
